governing_question: Does Constitutional Capitalism still work when Arkansas gets unlucky?
stance: A prosperity system that only works during prosperity is not a prosperity system. We do not predict these shocks—we ask what happens if they occur.

efficiency_resilience_principle.statement: Efficiency determines how well a system performs when conditions are favorable. Resilience determines whether the system still belongs to the people when conditions are not.
efficiency_resilience_principle.note: Locked unless later evidence disproves. Goal: one bad year, failed industry, technology shock, federal change, disaster, or generation of bad leadership cannot unravel two generations of accumulated prosperity.

shocks.name: Federal funding contraction
assume: reduced / delayed / restructured / reconditioned federal support

shocks.name: Extreme weather / disaster
assume: tornado / flood / drought / heat / winter / infrastructure failure categories

shocks.name: Energy disruption
assume: grid interruption and/or fuel-price spike and/or regional supply constraint

shocks.name: AI employment shock
assume: GRADUAL / SECTOR / BROAD productivity scenarios—not a single unemployment forecast

shocks.name: Demographic / population shock
assume: decline OR surge—both can break systems

shocks.name: Major employer / industry failure
assume: county monopsony employer closes; 500 jobs illustrative cascade

recession.title: Recession attack — procyclicality
recession.question: Does our fiscal architecture become weakest precisely when households need it most?
recession.finding: If public-income sources collapse alongside household incomes, we have correlated state and household balance sheets—not resilience. Automatic stabilizers + stabilization reserves required. Public-income feeders that are highly cyclical are CORRELATED RISK until proven otherwise.

financial_crash.title: Severe financial crash — Intergenerational Capital
financial_crash.question: What happens when the asset side of the public balance sheet falls at the exact moment spending pressure explodes?

rule.name: Public Asset Drawdown Rule
rule.text: No government may liquidate generational assets casually because a recession created political pressure. Drawdown only under predefined emergency rules, with replenishment schedule, transparency, and essential-function priority.

financial_crash.finding: Unprotected intergenerational capital under crash pressure FAILED UNDER STRESS as designed. Drawdown Rule + reserve separation SURVIVE.

inflation_rates.title: Inflation & interest-rate shocks
inflation_rates.rate_fragile: Any project whose viability depends on permanently cheap capital is marked RATE FRAGILE.
inflation_rates.finding: Household Surplus crushed by essentials inflation even if nominal wages rise. Housing/energy/infra/PPP marked RATE FRAGILE without stress paths. Joins 4.3 housing absorption findings.

federal_contraction.title: Federal funding contraction — Arkansas-specific

classes.plain: Cannot presently operate at intended scale without federal money
Arkansas contributes; federal dollars materially multiply capacity
Arkansas could maintain the function independently
Loss would create immediate household/systemic danger

federal_contraction.finding: Federal dependence map is a Stage 4 deliverable—not a forecast of cuts. TRANSITION_CRITICAL functions need contingency architecture before any tax-transition talk. Exact bind series remain OPEN (joins 4.1 OV-31-01).

revenue_concentration.title: State revenue shock — Revenue Concentration Rule
revenue_concentration.rule: Never replace diversified taxation with a dangerously concentrated public-income dependency.
revenue_concentration.finding: Single-source public-income dreams FAIL UNDER STRESS as replacement architecture. Diversity + stabilization reserves required. Numeric ceiling deferred; principle locked.

enterprise_failure.title: Public-enterprise failure — Failure Firewall
questions: Does failure contaminate other public assets?
firewall: No cross-collateralizing essential public assets without extraordinary justification
Failure must be possible—or there is no market discipline
enterprise_failure.finding: Confirms 4.1 ownership-by-function, 4.2 no private debt guarantee, 4.3 additionality. Soft-budget public enterprises FAILED UNDER STRESS.

disaster.title: Natural disaster / physical attack
disaster.finding: Productive Systems Dependency Matrix (3.6) is the stress instrument. Single-point failures in water/energy/comms are SINGLE_POINT_FAILURE until redundancy justified (OV-36-04).

strategic_capacity_food.title: Food-system shock — Strategic Capacity
strategic_capacity_food.concept: Strategic Capacity: capacity that may not always be the cheapest source in normal conditions but has measurable value during disruption.
strategic_capacity_food.question: What minimum local/regional capacity is economically worth maintaining as resilience insurance?
strategic_capacity_food.finding: Not self-sufficiency. Not local-always-better (4.1/4.3). Strategic Capacity applies to food, energy, healthcare, water, digital infrastructure.

energy.title: Energy disruption — independence ≠ resilience
energy.finding: Producing large energy quantities does not automatically keep critical functions online during disruption. OV-36-02 energy export/reliability frontier remains UNPROVEN as quantity bind; resilience distinction SURVIVES.

ai_shock.title: AI displacement shock
scenarios: GRADUAL — tasks change faster than occupations disappear
SECTOR SHOCK — occupational families contract rapidly
BROAD PRODUCTIVITY SHOCK — labor demand shifts across many services
ai_shock.honesty: Constitutional Capitalism cannot promise that retraining solves every displacement. Some transitions may structurally reduce demand for particular forms of labor.
ai_shock.finding: Ownership of AI productivity + household surplus transmission are load-bearing. Retraining-as-universal-fix FAILED UNDER STRESS as a slogan.

employer_failure.title: Major employer failure — Community Concentration
employer_failure.cascade: jobs↓ → income↓ → local spending↓ → small business↓ → property values → school/local revenue↓ → outmigration → remaining households carry fixed costs

index.name: Community Concentration Index (architecture)
index.note: Not a final formula this pass—dependency tracking required.

employer_failure.finding: Monopsony counties are SINGLE_POINT_FAILURE communities until diversification/strategic capacity exists.

population_decline.title: Population-loss — Graceful Contraction
population_decline.concept: Graceful Contraction: maintain quality of life with fewer residents; not every place must grow forever.
population_decline.finding: Fixed-cost infrastructure for peak population without contraction planning FAILED UNDER STRESS. Population decline ≠ automatic failure if per-household capability holds.

population_growth.title: Population-growth — Growth Absorption Capacity
population_growth.concept: Growth Absorption Capacity: how quickly housing, infrastructure, and essential services expand without destroying the prosperity gains that attracted people.
population_growth.finding: Success can break systems. Joins 4.3 housing findings. Growth without absorption capacity FAILED UNDER STRESS as prosperity strategy.

political_turnover.title: Political turnover — Institutional Continuity Test
political_turnover.question: What happens when the people who built the system lose an election?
political_turnover.finding: Durable system cannot depend on ideological continuity. Deep institutional design → PASS_4_5. Continuity Test architecture SURVIVES.

intergenerational_moral.title: Intergenerational capital — present necessity vs future capability
intergenerational_moral.objection: Why shouldn't today's struggling households spend the money?
intergenerational_moral.finding: Compounding alone is not a moral answer. Intergenerational capital survives only with defensible rules for when present emergency can override future preservation—tied to essential-function floors and Drawdown Rule. Unconditional lockboxes that ignore present catastrophe FAIL the moral attack; unconditional raids FAIL the future attack.

learning_loop.title: After-action learning without antifragile fantasy
learning_loop.note: Do not claim antifragile economy without evidence. Require learnable shock loops via Measurement architecture.

correlated_shocks.title: Correlated-failure tests

cases.name: Recession + federal contraction
cases.risk: Household need↑ while state capacity↓ and federal multiplier↓

cases.name: Inflation + energy disruption
cases.risk: Household Surplus crushed; critical facilities compete for fuel/power

cases.name: Employer closure + population loss + housing-value decline
Financial crash + revenue decline + public-asset decline + household need↑
cases.risk: Drawdown pressure on intergenerational capital; soft-budget temptation

cases.name: Fashionable public investment concentration → private pile-in → industry collapse → correlated pensions → job loss → revenue collapse
cases.risk: Public investment without diversification/additionality becomes systemic catastrophe, not mere low return

correlated_shocks.finding: One-shock preparedness is insufficient. Correlation maps are required for public investment, pensions, and community concentration.

measures.q: Is the rebuilt system less vulnerable?

essential_function_floors.title: Essential-function floors
essential_function_floors.rule: During severe fiscal stress, these receive defined priority before discretionary expansion. Architecture now; funding numbers later.

reserve_architecture.title: Reserve architecture — not one rainy-day fund
reserve_architecture.rule: Do not raid whichever account has money. Purpose-separated reserves with draw rules.

household_shock_test.title: Household shock test
household_shock_test.finding: A resilient state composed of fragile households isn't resilient. Joins Household Prosperity unit of success.

five_state_resilience.title: Five-State Resilience Test (bounded)
five_state_resilience.purpose: Not which state is best—what structural characteristics repeatedly make states more or less capable of absorbing shocks?
five_state_resilience.finding: Comparative frame SURVIVES; full five-state primary bind remains OPEN this pass—architecture and panel locked for continued Stage 4 / implementation binds.

system_stress_matrix.title: System Stress Matrix (systems × shocks) — summary grades

rows.note: Inflation/job loss hit directly; needs liquidity/insurance mechanisms
Cyclical feeders correlate with recession; COUNTABLE still $0
Failure Firewall or soft budget fails
Already fiscally failed near-term; stress makes earlier retirement worse
AI shock; retraining not universal fix
Success and failure both stress supply

proposition_board.proposition: Unprotected intergenerational capital under crash politics
Projects viable only under permanently cheap capital
Near-term dual tax abolition under shock
Present-emergency override rules for intergenerational capital

ov_cx_disposition.note: Energy export share / reliability frontier unbound; independence≠resilience distinction locked
Redundancy vs waste — Strategic Capacity / single-point mapping; numeric waste line still open
Broadband statewide primary bind still open; digital strategic capacity flagged
Care-capacity metrics for Production Balance Sheet still open; essential-floor priority locked
County Demand Map without false shortage — method caution under shock; bind after ADWS/LWDA

what_changed_format.what_we_expected: A system designed for growth and household prosperity would remain adequate if shocks were rare.
what_changed_format.what_we_tested: 12-shock deck; recession/crash/inflation/rates; federal and state revenue; enterprise failure; disaster/food/energy; AI; employer concentration; population decline/growth; turnover; correlated shocks; household shocks; intergenerational moral attack.
what_changed_format.what_evidence_supports: Procyclicality patterns; soft-budget enterprise failures; capitalization/housing under growth; fixed-cost decline; federal leverage realities; rate sensitivity of capital projects.
what_changed_format.what_breaks: Energy-volume-as-resilience; retraining-as-universal-AI-fix; population-growth scoreboard; unprotected generational assets; one-shock planning; near-term dual abolition under stress; RATE FRAGILE projects; soft-budget public enterprises.
what_changed_format.what_needs_guardrails: Drawdown Rule; Revenue Concentration Rule; Failure Firewall; Strategic Capacity; Graceful Contraction; Growth Absorption; Community Concentration tracking; Resilience Waterfall; essential floors; Continuity Test.
what_changed_format.what_remains_unknown: Five-state full bind; energy export series; broadband bind; care-capacity metrics; Demand Map binds; IP share calibration.
what_changed_format.what_we_changed: Locked efficiency/resilience principle; required shock architecture across fiscal and household systems; marked RATE FRAGILE and SINGLE_POINT_FAILURE classes.
